CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   C. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stewardship over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
   D. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

9. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   D. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   C. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Functions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Functions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Functions of the Bible.
   D. Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   B. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
